title: Agora Workbench: Stateless MCP Gateway Policy Cascades & Dispatcher Pool Routing Strategies
summary: GatewayServer and DispatcherServer decouple governance and scaling from CodeExecutionServer kernels. GatewayServer cascades parallel_execute blocks to suppress companion poll/collect/cancel tools, filters submitted code against blocked_tools and allowed_tools, and enforces per-user 60-second sliding-window rate limits. DispatcherServer coordinates identical worker pools under an asyncio.Lock using weighted round_robin, least_loaded active call tracking, session affinity, and configurable error/reroute failure policies.

GatewayServer companion tool block cascades and 60s sliding-window rate-limit enforcement
WorkerConfig weights and DispatcherConfig pool routing settings

_select_worker under _routing_lock supporting round_robin weights, least_loaded active counts, and failure rerouting
